summary: Full E2E testing of CivicFix (no-auth civic issue reporting app). Backend: 18 pytest tests covering all API endpoints (upload/files, issues CRUD, keyword classification pothole/garbage/streetlight/uncategorized, filters by category/status/reporter_id, idempotent confirm, comments, status mapping acknowledged->in_progress/resolved->resolved, category update, admin metrics) — 18/18 PASS. Frontend: exercised all data-testid selectors across / (map+filters+list+FAB+locate), /issue/:id (confirm, comment, timeline), /my-issues (sort toggle), /admin (metrics, filters, row edit panel with category/status/note/save). Full report wizard flow completed E2E on mobile viewport: photo upload -> location confirm -> Nominatim reverse-geocoded address 'Sadar Bazar Main Road, ... Gurugram, Haryana' -> description -> submit -> redirected to /issue/:id with 'Report submitted!' success toast and pothole category auto-classified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_status: 'acknowledged' status maps to top-level 'in_progress' — this deviates from typical UX where an acknowledged issue is a distinct top-level state. The spec explicitly requests this mapping so it is correct per spec, but consider surfacing 'Acknowledged' distinctly in the citizen UI (timeline already handles it). No bug.
server.py list_issues uses to_list(1000) with no pagination — fine for MVP; add pagination when data grows.
storage.py / EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is used for object storage per spec — key present in backend/.env, storage init succeeded (verified via upload+download round trip in tests).
Frontend geolocation gracefully falls back to Gurugram center when permission denied — verified pins render.
No auth per spec — confirmed no login/signup surfaces exist.
test_credentials: N/A — app has no auth by design.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral issues prefixed with TEST_ address text; DB grows with test data but does not affect functionality. 3 demo issues were already seeded by backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (reusable). All API contracts validated including auto-categorization keywords, idempotent confirm, and status mapping. Frontend all data-testid selectors present and working: filter-chip-{all|pothole|garbage|streetlight|water|other}, report-issue-fab, locate-me-btn, toggle-list-btn, issue-card-<id>, confirm-issue-btn, comment-input, post-comment-btn, sort-toggle-btn, admin-status-filter, admin-category-filter, admin-row-<id>, admin-category-select, admin-status-select, admin-note-input, admin-save-btn, photo-input, photo-next-btn, confirm-location-btn, resolved-address, address-edit-btn, address-confirm-btn, description-input, submit-report-btn. Full wizard e2e submission verified.
